calibration.note: scores are uncalibrated model scores; no temperature, Platt or isotonic fit

code.scope: src/, configs/, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, requirements.lock, .python-version (tests/, app/ excluded)

corruptions.blur: separable Gaussian; kernel size 2*ceil(3*sigma)+1; reflect padding
corruptions.clipping: brightness and noise outputs clipped to [0, 1]
corruptions.noise: zero-mean Gaussian, one draw per decoded pixel (one channel for grayscale)
corruptions.pixel_space: decoded [0, 1] values at native resolution, before resize/normalization

seed.derivation: uint64 = first 8 bytes (big-endian) of SHA-256 over the canonical JSON label list

demo.rule: highest validation macro-F1 among the study's methods at the demo cell; exact ties go to the lexically first method name

threshold.rule: highest threshold in {0.00, 0.05, ..., 1.00} with validation coverage >= 0.80; review when the maximum score is strictly below it

metrics.class_set: all declared classes of the dataset's class map

definitions.balanced_accuracy: mean over all classes of recall_c
definitions.confusion: raw C x C counts (rows = true class) and row-normalized (empty rows null)
definitions.macro_f1: mean over all classes of F1_c = 2 TP_c / (2 TP_c + FP_c + FN_c)
definitions.per_class: precision, recall, F1 and support for every declared class
definitions.top5: Flowers102 only; classes ranked by score, ties to the lower class ID

metrics.prediction: argmax of the score vector; ties go to the lowest class ID

replay.order_rule: test image IDs sorted ascending, then permuted once; same order per stream

rng.derivation: uint64 = first 8 bytes (big-endian) of SHA-256 over the canonical JSON label list

report_rules.aggregation: per dataset x K x method: mean and sample SD (ddof=1) over distinct runs; a deterministic duplicate counts once
report_rules.intervals: no population confidence interval is inferred from five seeds
report_rules.one_result_per_run: each sealed run is evaluated on test exactly once
report_rules.paired: per dataset x K: method differences matched on support seed
report_rules.primary_metric: macro_f1 (top-1, balanced accuracy, per-class and confusion also reported)
report_rules.robustness: corruption metrics are reported apart from the primary benchmark; each derivative is paired with its clean parent and never counted as a new test image

scorer.review_rule: review when the maximum score is strictly below the threshold
scorer.score: maximum class score: softmax(logits) for learned methods, softmax(-squared distance) for prototypes; an uncalibrated model score, not a probability of being right

score_kinds.prototypes: softmax(-squared Euclidean distance) at scale 1; uncalibrated model score

scorer.selection_rule: highest grid threshold with validation coverage >= 0.80

test_plan.evaluate: every sealed run once, on the full held-out test split of its dataset (clean images), with the same inference code as validation
test_plan.invalidation: a changed recipe, checkpoint, support, scorer, threshold, corruption protocol or test selection invalidates the seal
test_plan.outputs: predictions_test.csv and test_metrics.json in each sealed attempt folder
test_plan.repeat_policy: one result per sealed run; a recorded evaluation is never re-run

robustness.outputs: robustness/ in the demo attempt folder
